prompt:
Create ONE clean top-down orthographic FLOOR PLAN illustration, seen exactly from
directly above, of the small, intimate modern living room shown in the reference
image. Ceiling removed, no perspective, no people, no animals, no text, labels,
numbers, dimensions, compass or legend.

Layout to preserve from the reference: the open entrance door in the LEFT wall
(door swing visible), with a narrow console and coat hooks beside it; a dark grey
L-shaped sofa in the left-centre, its long side facing right toward the TV and its
short return extending toward the back wall; a knitted throw on the sofa; a
rectangular wooden coffee table in the centre in front of the sofa with a mug,
a small bowl, a remote and books; a dark patterned rectangular rug under the
table; a small amber table lamp on a side table behind the sofa at the left, with
a large potted plant beside it; a floor-to-ceiling window with curtains across
the BACK wall (top of the plan); on the RIGHT wall a low wooden TV cabinet with a
flat TV facing the sofa, and a tall bookshelf near the back-right corner; warm
wooden parquet floor. Compact room, uncluttered, plausible furniture scale.

Render the plan as a readable painted architectural illustration in the same
graphic language as the reference: fine visible contours, flat painted tones,
dark grey sofa, warm wood, dark rug, soft even neutral light so all furniture is
legible (no dramatic night shadows). Show the lamp position with a small warm glow
and the TV screen as a thin cool-green line. 16:9 frame with the room centred.
